% Pattern: theorem/macro/article. A command that is a whole numbered
% environment with no title, and a command that opens a lemma and labels it.
% Both are items, and they share the counter of the lemmas.
% from math/0406514
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.1 labels=a
% want sta-1 unknown 1.2
% want lem-2 statement/lemma 1.3
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{lem}{Lemma}[section]
\newtheorem{sta}[lem]{}
\def\lbl#1{\label{#1}}
\def\lemm#1{ \begin{lem} \lbl{#1} }
\def\st { \begin{sta} \ \end{sta}}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\lemm{a} Each tree is a graph. \end{lem}
\st Let $T$ be a tree.
\begin{lem} Each path is a tree. \end{lem}
\end{document}
